# KHUX Browser Installer 2.0.1

The Windows setup for the preserved KINGDOM HEARTS Union chi Theater + Dark Road
5.0.1 WW browser edition now has a cleaner setup window and simpler launch.

## Download and install

1. Download **KHUX-Windows-Setup.zip** from the Assets section below.
2. Right-click the downloaded ZIP and choose **Extract All**.
3. Open the extracted folder and double-click **START SETUP.cmd**. Keep the App folder beside it.
4. Let setup check, download and prepare the game. Then click **Launch Game**.
5. On the first launch only, click **Copy Content folder path** in setup. In the game,
   click **Game folder / Choose Files**, paste the path into the folder picker's address
   bar, select the Content folder and confirm Upload / Select Folder. This imports files
   locally. Wait for the title screen.
6. Later, use **KINGDOM HEARTS UX + Dark Road** on your desktop and click Start when shown.

You need 64-bit Windows 10/11, Windows PowerShell 5.1, .NET Framework, internet during
setup and about 10 GB free for a new installation. The game works offline after setup
and the first successful import. The launcher no longer needs Windows Script Host.

## Faster downloads and automatic resume

The downloader uses verified Internet Archive storage servers, checks whether one,
two or four connections help, and falls back to one connection when needed. It shows
progress, download speed and estimated time remaining. Speeds depend on your connection
and the Archive servers.

Use **Pause setup** to stop safely. After a failure or interruption, run START SETUP.cmd
again: setup automatically reuses verified files and resumes saved download chunks.
It retries temporary failures and checks file integrity. Complete existing content
does not need another download or extraction.

## Your saves

Setup preserves existing game files, browser profiles, saves and desktop shortcuts.
It keeps the existing GameProfile directory and original game path. A differing
existing game file stops setup and stays intact.

For backup instructions, click **Save backup / restore guide** in the completion window.
Close Chrome fully before backing up the entire GameProfile folder. Keep the original
installation path, do not clear browser site data, and do not delete GameProfile.
Setup never replaces your profile to restore a backup.

## What changed and what was tested

- One setup entry, internal files grouped under App, and a clearer four-step window.
- Completion buttons for Launch Game, Content folder copying and save backup guidance.
- Direct launcher without a Script Host dependency; no automatic Notepad launch.
- Installed instructions, configuration and logs grouped under Setup.
- The tested optimized downloader and original game runtime are unchanged.

Isolated tests passed for fresh installation, existing installation/upgrade, interrupted
downloads and resume, checksum/corruption recovery, extraction, shortcuts, offline first
import and restart, Union chi menu and Dark Road startup, whole-profile backup/restore
and completion controls. All 222 existing test-profile files stayed unchanged during
an installer rerun. No real user saves were touched; a complete gameplay playthrough
was not performed. This publishes the already-tested package without rebuilding it.

## Game files are not bundled

This ZIP contains only installer code, checksum metadata and instructions/guide files.
**No game content, browser binaries, browser saves, credentials or private files are
bundled.** Setup downloads game files from the original
[Internet Archive preservation collection](https://archive.org/details/khux-5.0.1-ww-web)
and its own storage servers, and obtains Chrome from Google's official distribution.
No game files have been uploaded to this release.

This is an unofficial preservation project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by
Square Enix or Disney. Union chi is the final offline Theater/avatar edition; Dark Road
is the offline browser version.
